Name: Ev3nth0riz0n's Goth Shane
Author: Ev3nth0riz0n
Description:
Features (version 1.3.0):

[list]
[*][b]Permanent Gothic Look for All Seasons (Including Beach Outfit):[/b] Shane's appearance is updated to reflect his goth style seen during Emily's 8-heart event. This includes darker clothing, makeup, and a new hairstyle that stands out in Pelican Town. Now includes a winter outfit, ensuring Shane's Gothic style is consistent throughout the year.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Character Sprite and Portraits:[/b] All of Shane's character sprites and portraits have been updated to match his new Gothic look, providing a consistent experience whether you're interacting with him in town or watching cutscenes.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Immersive Experience:[/b] The mod maintains the game's original atmosphere and dialogue while adding a fresh visual twist to Shane's character, making his appearance more unique.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Customization Options:[/b] Players can now choose whether they want Shane to wear a hat on the beach or not, as well as customize his winter outfit to better suit their preferences.
[/list]Future Updates:[list]
[*][b]New Dialogues[/b]
[*][b]New Customization Options[/b]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Shane recieved winter outfit with one customisation option..
